mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We currently have overcast skies and a temperature of 63 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School under a Third Quarter moon. There is an International Space Station pass tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

In city news, Liz Gay has been named the new Fitch-Rona E M S Deputy Chief of Administration, bringing extensive emergency operations and training experience to the community. Additionally, residents are reminded that Pellitteri Waste Systems provides weekly refuse and biweekly recycling collection for the city.

For local events, today features trivia nights at Hop Haus Brewing Co, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, or trivia at The Bogey Factory.

In the weekly police recap, on Saturday, October 25th at 5:34 AM, officers were dispatched to Plympton Street and Rita Avenue for a vehicle stopped at the intersection for over 20 minutes, where a 40-year-old Verona man was found passed out behind the wheel and arrested for an O W I first offence.
Over at Culver's, doors open today at 10:00 AM. Stop by to enjoy today's featured Flavor of the Day, Turtle Cheesecake.
